title: Reading Section A 选词填空
paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
passage: Arriving in a research lab for the first time, many undergraduates imagine that they will spend most of their time making exciting discoveries. In practice, the first weeks are more about observation. A good supervisor will ask new students to {{1}} everything they do, from the temperature of a water bath to the strange noise a machine makes. Keeping a careful record may feel boring, but it is the only way to {{2}} an unexpected result later. Beginners also need to accept that experiments often fail. Rather than hiding a failed attempt, lab members discuss it at weekly meetings, where a problem that seems unusual to one student may be {{3}} to someone else. With time, students learn to {{4}} their methods when the data do not make sense. They also discover that asking a short question early can {{5}} hours of wasted work. Patience is another lesson: some measurements need weeks before any pattern becomes {{6}}. For those who stay, the work brings a quiet {{7}} that no single finished result can offer. Many students say the experience {{8}} their idea of what science really is. They come to see that confidence grows slowly, and that the most valuable habit in a lab is not speed but {{9}}. blanks.explain: document 意为「记录、存档」，document everything they do 即把所做的一切记录下来，与后文 keeping a careful record 呼应。
explain 意为「解释」，此处指只有记录清楚，日后才能解释异常结果出现的原因。
be familiar to sb 意为「某人对……熟悉」，a problem may be familiar to someone else 指别人可能早已遇到过这个问题。
adjust 意为「调整」，adjust their methods 指数据说不通时调整实验方法。
prevent 意为「防止、避免」，prevent hours of wasted work 即避免浪费数小时的工作。
obvious 意为「明显的」，pattern becomes obvious 指规律变得清晰可见，需要数周的测量。
satisfaction 为名词「满足感」，a quiet satisfaction 指那种安静的满足，与单个实验结果形成对照。
changed 是 change 的过去式，the experience changed their idea 指这段经历改变了他们对科学的认识。
patience 为名词「耐心」，not speed but patience 与前文 Patience is another lesson 呼应。
complete 意为「完成」，complete a project from start to finish 指独立完成一个小项目。
